newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian stocks show moderate rise, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Belgian stocks show moderate rise, more gains seen.

text.p: Belgian shares continued higher on Tuesday after six consecutive days of gains, with good fundamentals and the prospect of dividend payouts in the weeks ahead seen keeping the market buoyant, dealers said.

"Industrials should perform well because of the low interest rates (and) I'm confident for economic recovery," one dealer said, noting the good gearing in the sector. He expected pharmaceuticals and chemicals to do well, with UCB in favour because of its positive growth forecast and Tessenderlo also liked. Retailers Colruyt and Delhaize looked expensive though, he said.
